blocks.text: I want to take a moment here to remember Brother Neal Frisby. It’s been one year since he passed away, April 29, 2005. He left us with so much to watch for - events coming swiftly. And look what has happened since he went home to be with the Lord! God is always in preparation for mankind. Through his ministry we now know the time and season that the Lord will return, for if you observe the world you can hardly help not to see the complex problems that the world is facing. I will list a few of the events since Brother Frisby’s passing. – The escalated war in Iraq and a dangerous problem in Iran over their nuclear program, major hurricanes ravaged the U.S. - Hurricane Katrina followed by Rita in TX. and Wilma in FL. caused between $60-$100 billion in damages. Many earthquakes struck the world killing thousands of people. Also major cyclones hit Australia. – Recently the noted private forecaster Accu-Weather said in a special report that “we are a little more than two months before the start of hurricane season in the Atlantic” and they are also predicting the Northeast is due for a major hurricane. “With the weather patterns and hydrology we’re seeing in the oceans, the likelihood of a major hurricane making landfall in the Northeast is not a question of if, but when.” The last major hurricane to strike the Northeast was in 1938 striking Long Island and Providence, R.I. killing 600 people. – And now some quotes from Neal Frisby:

PROPHECY – NATURE TRAVAILING – (Scroll #278) The 4 elements will be raging on as a sign. Fire, wind, earth, and water! Plus, volcanic activity will continue loosening the continental shelves, land, sea, and cities! Super quakes of Biblical proportions will start. Lives and buildings destroyed. Mighty winds and great water hurricanes, etc. will occur! – Note: God’s 7 thunders are now working with the midnight cry as the former and latter rain merge together to take out the elect. Behold, I come quickly! Blessed is he that watcheth and are active in preparation!

APOCALYPTIC FORECAST – The spirit speaketh expressively for the world will be hanging in the balance! Note: This could mean a lot of things – axis turning, apocalypse, dictatorship, etc. Armageddon war – Pentecost given 1904-05 – The outpouring 2001-2010 – (Jews took control of old city 1967) – if you add 40 year generation you come up with 2007 – Covenant possible, translation from now until then. The world is right for the predicted coming calamities, and great shall the cry of the earth be! – The terrorists will not hesitate in the future to spread pestilence, biological diseases and destructive methods on the USA and other nations! (Editor’s note: Iran is a major part of terrorist activities.) THE AGE OF THE DRAGON – (Scroll #248) We just wrote of China who uses the dragon as their symbol. But scripturally that’s only part of it. The real dragon is worldwide Babylon. The dragon of Rev. 12:3 – and the one the false church rides in Rev. Chap. 17 and the commercial part is Rev. Chap. 18. – “Through electronics, laser and computer the whole world will be connected together with these new dimensional inventions that are already working and will increase daily!” – The scarlet prince will use the god of forces (magnetic waves) which includes all sorts of electronic inventions, atomic, energy, chemical and weather weapons! (Read Dan. 11:38) – They have the technology that already leads right to the mark of the beast soon! The USA is the leader above and also in this land of freedom and religion known as the lamb, which will also speak like a dragon in the future! (Rev. 13:11-13) Below these verses shows supernatural and science signs (inventions) of all kinds. This digital generation is speeding up the end of the age! The whole world will be caught up in this and every facet of modern life will be connected to it through these magnetic and fantasy forces, etc. END QUOTE. – China is a major force in the world today shaping events that will bring us to Armageddon in the near future. At the present time there is a great war over the energy and the vital resources of the earth. These will be the events that bring us to Armageddon.

Last month we were unable to include the last part of the wonderful letter. This part is on healing. “There are so many Scriptures to bear out God’s promises, and now here are some Scriptures of healing faith: Acts 4:30, “God is stretching forth His hand to heal! Acts 10:38, “Jesus healed ALL who were sick and oppressed of the devil!” Matt. 9:35, “Jesus healed every sickness and disease among the people.” And this promise is for YOU too! Matt. 4:23, “Jesus preached and healed ALL manner of sickness among the people!” He wants to touch you now, claim it! Ps. 103:3, “Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases!” Ps. 107:20, “He sent his word, and healed them!” And the power of the Lord is now present upon you to heal and prosper you as you believe from this day forward! – Luke 5:17-20. We are joint heirs of what the Lord has by faith! Hag. 2:8, “The Lord owns it all, including the silver and gold!” The healing and prosperity blessings belong to you! For all who write we will send a book called “Proper and Sure Faith!” It is anointed with truth and will definitely build your faith into a new realm! – We have many projects underway and your help will ensure that we continue to do our best for the Lord. A great blessing is on Brother Frisby’s ministry and those who help. May the Lord richly bless and keep you until He comes. Your Brother in Christ,
